text: At 2am, I stared at her Bali stories on my phone, then saw my 6-hour screen time pop up and felt totally empty.
11:42 pm. Staring at an unformatted Notion page again. My third night eating cold soup by the laptop, waiting for a single dollar to show up.
At 2 AM last Tuesday, I stared at my company quarterly report and wondered if an algorithm will write my next one.
At 6:00 PM, my gym bag sat by the front door. I stared at it from the couch for ten minutes, then put my shoes back in the closet.
At 38, unpacking my old art degree in a cramped kitchen, I felt sick. Everyone my age is a director. I'm just sharpening a 2B pencil again.
